status: DRAFT, not frozen. Written from source only (src/refute/core/io.py dumps_json, src/refute/packs/tess/pipeline.py build_result, src/refute/packs/tess/discover/measure.py chain, src/refute/packs/tess/report.py render_report). No golden file was opened. The frozen schema adds exact_keys from schema-keys.json.
p2: Decision P2 (#218 comment 7225754254), Codex's item 6: exact_key_regex makes exact every number whose last key names a threshold (required_probability in sensitivity blocks, src/refute/core/sensitivity.py:248; min_train_snr and max_duration_period_ratio in holdout rounds), under any pattern; keys_not_exact_under lets the fit's errors in v05.parameters (pipeline.py:825) be measurements although period_err_days is also a plan field; period_comparison.found_period_days (pipeline.py:898) is a measurement. Measurements printed inside test messages stay exact: section 3.1 maps numeric spans only in rendered reports, and the same message is a JSON string in the verdict, which compares exactly.
s1: Decision S1 (#218 comment 7227283917), Codex's round of R3, items 1 and 2: the keys of computed_keys_despite_name are computed measurements that the name rule would make exact; the exemption from the global exact_keys is narrowed to the one colliding path (v05.parameters.period_err_days, the fit's error, pipeline.py:829); configuration echoed under broad measurement patterns is exact (search.py:342 factor of the refinement, battery.py:650-657 the plan's systematic periods near the candidate); a sensitivity block's alternative is exact when the plan alone sets it (power.py:119, 178, 206; battery_v51_diff.py:311, 623, 651). After Codex's round 2 (s5/codex/answer-r2.md, item 1), the configuration inputs are exact too: tests[*].inputs (gauntlet.py:162-176, the fixture's stellar parameters), the target's magnitude, the median CROWDSAP and the neighbours' magnitudes and separations (battery.py:494-515), and the stellar mass (gauntlet.py:276-277, the given TIC mass or a function of the given logg and radius); and so are the effective detrending windows (battery.py:645 and 816, detrend_window_days; holdout.py:1184, hidden_detrend_window_days), which the writers apply as configuration (model_copy), compared exactly even when the measured period sets them.
